before: Backspace at the start of a list item joined it to the previous paragraph, and list numbering edits in suggesting mode landed untracked.
after: Backspace at the start of a list item removes its number with the existing numbering and paragraph property operations, and suggesting mode attributes those operations as paragraph property changes.
reason: The gesture emits the existing setParagraphProperties and setListNumbering operations, and the tracked form uses the existing w:pPrChange record those operations already support. No shared field or operation shape changes. Two collaborating editors converge through concurrent typing, a remote deletion in the item, concurrent presses, undo, redo, reconnect, and save and reopen.
